pins.title: Sleep Mask for Side Sleepers: Why It Slips, Leaks Light, or Presses on Your Ear
pins.subtitle: Three problems, three different fixes
pins.description: Mask feels fine on your back, then you roll over and the pillow pushes it toward one ear? A sleep mask for side sleepers has a harder job. The pillow drags the strap, the down-side cup gets pressed so light sneaks in by your nose, and the strap sits on top of your ear. We sort 3 picks by the problem they're built for. Not medical advice. Read the full guide. #sleepmask #sidesleeper #eyemask #sleepaccessories #bettersleep

pins.description: Which matters most to you on the pillow side? Comparing 3 sleep masks for side sleepers: Manta PRO, with C-shaped cups that per Manta lie flat at the temples and a strap angled above the ears; a newer mask with anti-slip grip zones; and a silk mask for the cheek. pins.title: Sleep Mask That Doesn't Slip Off: 5 Fit Tips for Side Sleepers
pins.subtitle: Snug, not tight
pins.description: Mask up on your forehead by morning? How to get a sleep mask that doesn't slip off: 1) Put the strap at the back of your head, not over your ears. 2) Keep it snug, not tight. 3) Tie long hair back loosely and center the fastener. 4) Try a smoother pillowcase. 5) Replace a stretched strap. Still seeing light on your side? Adjust the cups, then the strap angle. Not medical advice. Read the guide. #sleepmask #sidesleeper #sleeptips #eyemask #bettersleep

pins.title: Side-Sleeper Sleep Mask Checklist: 7 Things to Check Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: Look for the items that match your problem
pins.description: Save this before you buy a sleep mask for side sleepers. 1) Thin or flat temple side. 2) Cups that stay off your eyes. 3) Fastener at the back of your head. 4) Strap that can stay off the top of your ears. 5) Something that helps it stay in place. 6) Fabric that suits your cheek. 7) Washing directions and a return window that fit your risk. Not medical advice. Full checklist in the guide. #sleepmask #sidesleeper #eyemask #bedroomchecklist #sleepaccessories
